notes.title: The Cemetery Summer Update!
notes.notes:
*We recommend starting a new game for this update

The Attic continues to grow and expand revealing unexpected secrets and new areas...

New areas are now accessible:
- The Cemetery 
- The Windmill
- The Utility Room / Stairs 

Various new items have appeared...

5 Game Tokens can now be found and used in the Game Room

UI now shows:
- What key is being used to unlock a door
- What key is needed to unlock a door

Inventory, Map and Pause Menu updates

Main Menu updates
- More items appear in the Main Menu as you progress 

AI updates : 
- AI is more aggressive now 
- AI is more mobile

Various art and level updates...
Various lighting adjustments...
Various Bug Fixes
Various optimizations

Demo: 
Small lighting update
